Abstract Control and Status

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x58
Size:
0x4
Source:
debug_module.rdl

Description

Controls and status for abstract commands. Writing this register while an abstract command is executing (busy=1) sets cmderr to 1 (busy) if cmderr was 0.

Field Descriptions

_reserved_31_29

Reserved.

progbufsize

Size of the Program Buffer, in 32-bit words. Valid sizes are 0-16.

_reserved_23_13

Reserved.

busy

1: An abstract command is currently being executed. Set when 'command' is written, cleared on completion.

_reserved_11

Reserved.

cmderr

Abstract command error status. Remains set until cleared. Valid if busy=0. 0=none, 1=busy, 2=not_supported, 3=exception, 4=halt/resume, 5=bus, 7=other.

_reserved_7_4

Reserved.

datacount

Number of data registers (dataN) implemented. Valid sizes are 1-12.
